exposure: OP deliveries with head circumference ≥90th centile
OP deliveries with head circumference <90th centile
cohort: Term singleton deliveries at multiple centers from January 2010 to December 2014
finding: Persistent occiput posterior (OP) position combined with large head circumference (HC ≥90th centile) was associated with higher rates of operative delivery and prolonged second stage of labor compared to OP delivery with HC <90th centile.
mod_finding: Persistent occiput posterior (OP) position combined with large head circumference (HC ≥90th centile) was associated with higher rates of vacuum extraction and unplanned cesarean delivery.
